step.path.title: Where should nyxWM be installed?
step.path.desc: nyxWM installs for the current user only — no administrator rights are required.
path.label: Install folder
path.hint: A subfolder named "nyxWM" is created automatically inside the folder you choose.
step.options.title: Shortcuts and startup
step.options.desc: Both options can be changed later in the nyxWM settings.
options.autostart.desc: Adds a per-user startup entry so the window manager loads at sign-in.
options.shortcut.desc: Adds nyxWM to the Start Menu app list.
step.config.title: Configure nyxWM
step.config.desc: Defaults are already filled in — change only what you need.
config.cameraCustomPrompt: Custom button, e.g. MBUTTON or ALT+LEFT
config.mainModInvalid: Use CONTROL, ALT, SHIFT or WIN joined with +
config.hotkeysHint: Syntax: mainmod + key, for example "mainmod + space".
config.hotkeyInvalid: Hotkey must be a valid combination, e.g. mainmod + space
step.progress.title: Installing nyxWM
step.progress.desc: Downloads the latest release from GitHub and installs it.
progress.note: Downloading the latest release from GitHub.
install.busy: Installation is in progress. Wait for it to finish before closing the installer.
step.finish.title: All set
finish.heading: Installation complete
finish.subtitle: nyxWM has been installed for your user account.
